summary: Milestone 2026.05.161 completed 25 experiments in 118.9 minutes. Synthesis-only tasks dominated the wall time, particularly Exp 2056. GPU utilization on the 3 compute-bound tasks was efficient with no anomalous idling.
bottlenecks_identified: Synthesis-only task Exp 2056 was the primary bottleneck, consuming 63.7 minutes.
improvements_suggested: Optimize the synthesis pipeline to address the significant wall-time consumed by tasks like Exp 2056.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Investigate and reduce the execution time of Soft Bellman Equation Solver (Exp 2056).
Identify optimization opportunities for milestone audits and retrospectives.
Maintain efficient GPU utilization for future compute-bound experiments.
meta_reflection: Synthesis-only tasks continue to be the primary driver of milestone wall time, overshadowing compute-bound tasks. Ensuring the synthesis pipeline is as efficient as possible will yield the most significant time savings in future milestones.
